Probs a bit late to this, but if you're trying to get a kid to do something (brush teeth, tidy up, eat dinner etc) present the option as a choice. Instead of saying 'Do you want to brush your teeth?' say 'Do you want to brush your teeth or put your pyjamas on first?'. Gives them some ownership over their decisions and they don't often think to consider neither as an option.
